jobs.description: Soldering operatorWorking as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.Your tasks are, amongst others:· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspectionYou will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.What Benchmark has to offer to you:· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.What do we ask of you?· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.· Being able to work very precise and accurate.· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.About Benchmark:Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. In Almelo, the Netherlands, you will be working with up to 750 colleagues.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Wartung, Reparatur, InstandhaltungErweiterte Kenntnisse: Feinlöten, Hartlöten, Löten, Weichlöten, Maschinenführung, Anlagenführung, -bedienung
